# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who follows Christ. Notice the progression: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. These aren't passive suggestions—they're commands that require intentional effort and discipline. The world constantly pressures us to drift, to compromise, to soften our convictions. But Paul calls us to vigilance first. A warrior who isn't watchful gets ambushed. A man who doesn't stand firm gets swept away by the current of culture. "Act like men" isn't about bravado or toughness—it's about maturity, responsibility, and courage under pressure. And true strength? It's not found in our own muscles or willpower. It flows from a life rooted in Christ. The strongest man in the room is the one on his knees before God, then standing firm before the world. Today, you'll face moments that test your faith—at work, at home, in private. Watch for the enemy's schemes. Stand firm on God's truth. Lead with courage. Draw your strength from the Lord, not yourself.
## Daily Challenge
Do 3 sets of 10 pushups, pausing between each set to pray: "Lord, make me watchful, firm, and strong in You today."
